events.info: Three names. One tour. And a fall lineup that is almost too impressive to believe. When TOBYMAC, THIRD DAY, CHRIS TOMLIN tour together, it is a night big enough to make people book flights, text friends, and clear the calendar! The set list is full of endless #1 hits and award-winning music to make this an unforgettable show. Three headliners. No filler. You will pay for the seat, but you are bound to spend the night on your feet!

events.name: Campus Nights
events.info: Known for creating unforgettable worship experiences, ELEVATION RHYTHM joins Campus Nights with guest speaker Markus McFolling this fall for eight exclusive events designed to inspire a generation to follow Jesus. Expect powerful worship, authentic community, and meaningful moments that bring people together. More than a concert. Campus Nights is a generation pursuing Jesus together. TICKET TYPES: VIP - Get a VIP ticket for a truly unforgettable night! VIP tickets include first entry into the venue to choose the best seats in the house, a photo with the artists, and an exlusive souvenir tour laminate! Doors for VIP open at 5:15pm. You must arrive by 5:30pm to take part in the VIP experience. Late arrivals will miss out on VIP perks. Early Entry - Snag a great seat with an Early Entry ticket! Early Entry tickets include early access into the venue to choose your seats! Doors open at 6:00pm, you must arrive by 6:15pm for early entry access. Late arrivals will miss out on priority seating. General Admission & Student Tickets - all seating is first come, first served. Doors open at 6:15pm. IMPORTANT INFO: For ADA requests please email ticketsupport@echoconcerts.com All ticket sales are final Ticket prices are subject to increase at the door Kids 2 and under are free but must sit on a lap and not take a seat Any discounts that become available later are for new, separate purchases and do not apply to previously purchased tickets To ensure the safety of our ticket buyers and event attendees, we do not allow third-party ticket sales for any Echo event. Recently, there has been a rise in scams and fraudulent activity related to online ticket sales, we strongly encourage you to buy tickets through the official ticketing platform for any Echo event. The official ticket page can always be found at echoconcerts.com. Tickets purchased from third-party sources or unofficial ticketing websites are not guaranteed by Echo and may limit your access to important event updates or assistance.
